test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 9 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Guru Debaprasad Das Awardee Durga Charan Ranbir is a teacher and performer of which of the following classical dance forms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odissi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Durga Charan Ranbir** 

 
 
• **Shri Durga Charan Ranbir** was born in **1951** in **Kamaguru village in Orissa**.
 
• A prominent guru of **contemporary Odissi is Durga Charan Ranbir**.
 
• He received his **Odissi training from legendary gurus Debaprasad Das and Pankaj Charan Das**.
 
• Durga Charan Ranbir has succeeded in **carving out a unique dance path while following the teachings of his mentor**, Debaprasad Das.
 
• Critics have **praised **many of his choreographies.
 
• He provided **Odissi training in esteemed institutions** in a number of locations, including **Cuttack, Bhubaneshwar, Kolkata, Delhi, and the US**.
 
• He currently runs his own institution in **Bhubaneswar called Nrutyayan**.
 
• He has** received numerous honours** for his contributions to Odissi, including **the Orissa Sangeet Natak Akademi Award, Orissa Samman by the Orissa Press Academy, Veda Vyas Award of Bhanja Kala Kendra,** etc. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Guru Debaprasad Das**

 
 
• In the Indian state of **Odisha, Deba Prasad Das was born in 1932 **to a Karana family in the small town of** Keul Chabi Sua, which is close to Cuttack**.
 
• He was an I**ndian classical dance**r who was regarded by critics and connoisseurs as **one of the four founding gurus of the Indian classical dance style known as Odissi.** 
 
• His Odissi style is **strong and distinctive**.
 
• He received the **1974 Odisha Sangeet Natak Akademi Award** as well as the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 1977**.
 
• **Gayatri Chand**, a senior dancer in the Deba Prasad Das style,** wrote a book about him and his art called "Guru Debaprasad Das: Icon of Odissi" **after **25 years of his demise in 2012**.
